comments.author: @tysoncung
comments.text: The part that still gets me: Laos is the only country in Southeast Asia with no coastline, and it is the only one on this whole China-to-Singapore plan with trains actually running. 422 km, nearly half of it inside 75 tunnels, built with a 3.6 billion dollar Chinese loan, open since 3 December 2021. Thailand is still building towards Nong Khai, and Singapore has no track in the project at all. Sources are linked in the description. Has a big new railway or road been built near you, and did it change anything about your daily life?
